programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Gauja National Park in Latvia features diverse wildlife, red sandstone cliffs and a winding river that flows through forests shaped by long human history.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In the Alps
programme.desc: Secluded for many centuries in inaccessible valleys, the inhabitants of the Alps had no alternative but to rely on the healing powers of nature. A knowledge of herbs was deeply rooted in these mountain-dwellers’ everyday lives – until the twentieth century, when this wisdom became eclipsed by modern academic medicine. Today, Alpine herbs are witnessing a revival, as public interest in regional natural treasures grows. The potential of Alpine herbs is far from exhausted. In the Berchtesgaden Alps, the film shows Hubsi Ilsanker at work as a root-digger, a back-breaking job that has scarcely changed in four hundred years. Authorized by a special historic permit to supply the oldest gentian distillery in Germany, Hubsi digs for protected gentian roots in Berchtesgaden National Park. For yellow gentian is one of the most bitter medicinal herbs in the world, well suited for schnapps and as a general tonic.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret world of Herbs - In the Balkans
programme.desc: In the pristine nature and mild climate of southeastern Europe grows a unique diversity of wild plants. Far removed from major industry and polluted soils, the Balkan countries have become the largest exporter of herbs in Europe. In Bulgaria alone, more than 300,000 people work with domestic plants. The business is becoming increasingly lucrative. The film takes us to the Croatian coast. On the Adriatic island of Cres, the audience meets Mladen Dragoslavić. In May, when the sage begins to blossom, this beekeeper has one month to produce his income for an entire year – always with the goal of creating the best sage honey in the Balkans. Given a choice, the bees would never choose sage, for entering and exiting the narrow blossom is strenuous. Within three weeks, maximum, Mladen must remove his bees from the island. Otherwise they will die of exhaustion. In Skopje, the capital of Macedonia, the film visits Iva Yosifova. Hollyhock provides the raw material for her objects of art. The herb is medically beneficial, due to its mucilage, which is added to many cough tea mixtures. Iva, though, makes paper from hollyhock. Thanks to the herb’s long fibres, the paper can be spread onto objects and modeled. The technique produces delicate sculptures, as fragile as nature.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River - The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Florida - The Sunshine State
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Heart of New England
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust

programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

programme.title: Broad City: Bed Bugs
programme.desc: En fin, ny väska ger Abbi självförtroende under arbetslösheten. Ilana och Jaimé får hantera en i New York City oundviklig mardröm.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Tjejernas firande av 'kompisårsdagen' blir plötsligt farlig när de bevittnar nåt hemskt.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Abbi fyller 30. Abbi och Ilana reser genom hela Manhattan, och träffar både gamla och nya vänner.

programme.title: Broad City: SheWork and S**t Bucket
programme.desc: Ilana sätter igång med sin senaste affärsidé: En utomhusarbetsplats för alla rökare i New York City. Abbi står på sig mot sin hyresvärd när han vägrar renovera hennes avlopp.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana hälsar på en gammal flamma för att få ut sin Bitcoinandel. Abbi går till en tvättomat för första gången och blir av med sin favorittröja.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana upptäcker en hemsk hemlighet om Jaimé. Abbi försöker avancera från tröjvikare till fönsterkonstnär på Anthropologie.

programme.title: Broad City: Artsy Fartsy
programme.desc: Abbi blir inbjuden till ett fint konstevent på MoMA. Ilana och Lincoln stämmer av efter ett års förhållande.

programme.title: Broad City: Lost and Found
programme.desc: Tjejerna träffar en släkting till Ilana, en överlevare från Förintelsen, och tar med honom på dragbrunch. Abbi testar en ny look.

programme.title: Broad City: Shenanigans
programme.desc: Ilana rekryteras som hårmodell. Abbis nya kärlek påstår att hon inte är tillräckligt mogen.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana åker till 'Sleep No More', och Abbi försöker hitta rätt tillfälle att berätta nåt stort för Ilana.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana och Bevers säljer Abbis saker i New York City, Abbi får biljetter till Lil Wayne, och tjejerna gör en 'tripp'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Brudarna säger hej då.

programme.title: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
programme.desc: Ilana får nys om en hemlig Lil Wayne-konsert. Tillsammans med Abbi bufflar hon sig fram i New York. Tjejerna låter inget hindra dem från att skrapa ihop tillräckligt med pengar för biljetterna.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Kausi alkaa. Mitt i -lehden toimittajana työskentelevän Cajsan arkinen elämä saa uusia käänteitä, kun Rut tekee hänelle työtarjouksen, josta hän ei ole uskaltanut uneksiakaan – hän saa pyynnön kirjoittaa Rutin omaelämäkerran, jonka kustantaa Bonnier. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Vihreä aalto. Klara huomaa Ruthin blokanneen sekä hänet että Rillen Instagramissa ja tuntee olevansa hylätty tylsä äiti. Rille yrittää saada käsiinsä paketin. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Ajattelet vain itseäsi!. Wilma on saanut tarpeekseen joukkueestaan ja saaresta ja yrittää paeta kanoottiretken aikana. Konflikti riistäytyy käsistä, ja pian ollaan eksyksissä. Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Karkurit
programme.desc: Pidätysmääräystä pakoileva joogaguru on Karkuriyksikön tähtäimessä. Tuore tiimin jäsen Santiago ottaa peitepoliisin taitonsa käyttöön. Lori tunnistaa Karitan luo tunkeutuneen murtovarkaan. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Karkurit
programme.desc: Tytöt. Koulukodista karkaa teini-ikäinen tyttö, jota epäillään henkirikoksesta. Etsintää hankaloittaa se, että tyttö on liivijengin pomon tytär. Keissi koskettaa omien tyttäriensä kanssa kipuilevaa Tommia. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Vallan varjot
programme.desc: Nimetön lähde. Nina palkataan ulkoministerin lehdistösihteeriksi, ja poliittisesti koulimaton Weiss saakin heti suosiota. Maxien asuntoon murtaudutaan, lähde murhataan, ja konsulttitoimeksiannot tyrehtyvät kuin seinään. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Sokaistuneet
programme.desc: Maltassa Bea ja Peder antavat suhteelleen uuden mahdollisuuden, mutta ilta päättyy kyyneliin. Tukholmassa Pierre Eckervik yrittää välttää katastrofin. Carolina Neurathin todellisuuden innoittamaan romaaniin perustuva jännitysdraama nuoresta toimittajasta, joka ajautuu keskelle valtapelien, rahan ja salaisuuksien maailmaa. Tiivistunnelmaisen sarjan tähtinä Julia Ragnarsson ja Matias Varela. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Top Dog
programme.desc: Teddy käy tarkistamassa, että hän on kunnossa. Anina löytää Chamonin piilottaman puhelimen, ja Niko panikoi. Erittäin epäsopiva pari - juristi Emily (Josefin Asplund) ja ex-rikollinen Teddy (Alexej Manvelov) - tulevat yhteen jahdatessaan kidnappaajaa. Ruotsalainen trillerisarja perustuu Jens Lapiduksen menestyneeseen kirjatrilogiaan. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Murha Sandhamnissa
programme.desc: Kausi päättyy. Max, osa 2. Nora on huolissaan kadonneesta Alexanderista. Pär tajuaa tutkintansa liittyvän kahteen muuhun. Pommi uhkaa tuhota kaiken. Tukholman saaristo ei ole niin rauhallinen kuin luulit. Aaltojen lyödessä kallioita vasten rikostarkastaja syyttäjä Nora Linde taistelee arvaamatonta pahuutta vastaan. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Feed
programme.desc: Kauhuelokuva nuorista, jotka kutsutaan luksusleirintäalueelle erämaahan, missä vaanii jokin paha. Guldbaggenin yleisöpalkinnon voittaja.

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Hugh Grant. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Vaahteramäen Eemeli ja Iida
programme.desc: Kissankulman talossa, Vaahteramäen kylässä Smoolannissa asuu Eemeli ja hänen pikkusiskonsa Iida yhdessä isä Anttonin, äiti Alman, renki Aatun ja piika Liinan kanssa. Eemeli on kultainen pikkupoika, joka haluaisi kovasti olla avuksi, mutta hänen avuliaisuutensa helposti mielletään metkuiluksi.

programme.title: Astrid Lindgrens jul
programme.desc: Joulujaksoja kahdeksasta Astrid Lindgrenin rakastettuihin kertomuksiin perustuvasta elokuvasta, Pepistä ja Eemelistä Marikkiin ja Saariston lapsiin.

programme.title: Veijarikopla tulee taas
programme.desc: Neljännessä Jönssonliigaelokuvassa Sickan kumppaneineen sekaantuu poliittisiin juonitteluihin. Kaikki alkaa kunniallisella Ikean kaappausyrityksellä. Sickan kuitenkin huomaa, että joku käyttää Ikean huonekaluja aseiden salakuljetukseen.

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!

programme.desc: Yhteiset intressit. Alex ja Anna päättävät karkottaa yksinäisyyden ryhtymällä seksisuhteeseen. Mickan on varma avioerosta Fredden kanssa, jos yhteistä kiinnostuksen kohdetta ei löydy. Sundbergit aloittavat siivousfirmassa ja putsaavat sen talousasiatkin uuteen uskoon. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Fube kuvaa mainosvideota yrityksen uusista osallistamista ja moninaisuutta tukevista arvoista, ja Rut on ymmällään siitä, miksi hän ei saakaan toimia kampanjan kasvoina. Sen sijaan parrasvaloissa paistattelee uusi tulokas Nadja. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Jaettu ilo on kaksinkertainen ilo. Berndt ja Söderberg käyttäytyvät kuin vastarakastuneet teinit, mitä Klara pitää sopimattomana.Tomas huolehtii huonosta suhteestaan Berndtiin. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Totuus vai tehtävä?. Wilman pakosuunnitelma jatkuu joukkueen joutuessa rangaistuksena saarelle yksin. Soitettuaan taksiveneen hän löytää viinapullon ja joutuu leikkiin. Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Solsidan - onnea onkimassa
programme.desc: Yhteiset intressit. Alex ja Anna päättävät karkottaa yksinäisyyden ryhtymällä seksisuhteeseen. Mickan on varma avioerosta Fredden kanssa, jos yhteistä kiinnostuksen kohdetta ei löydy. Sundbergit aloittavat siivousfirmassa ja putsaavat sen talousasiatkin uuteen uskoon. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Jenny ilmoittautuu dinosauruskurssille pitääkseen opintotukensa, mutta ystävillä on ehdotus psykologiohjelmaan pääsystä. Saga vie Jennyn pubi-iltaan. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Agatha Christien Hjerson
programme.desc: Magnuksen löytyminen kuolleena muuttaa tilannetta. Epäilykset muita epäiltyjä kohtaan vahvistuvat. Pian saavutaan Maarianhaminaan ja aika loppuu. Moderni ruotsalainen arvoitusdekkari, jonka innoittajina olivat Agatha Christien kertomukset. Ainutlaatuinen murhatutkija Sven Hjerson (Johan Rheborg) muodostaa yllättävän etsiväkaksikon omapäisen tv-tuottajan (Hanna Alström) kanssa. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Hassella ja Fabianilla on eri näkemykset padelhallin käynnistämisestä, mikä näkyy selvästi radiohaastattelussa. Uhkaava padelkuningas tulee käymään. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Tobias saa korvauksen vankilaan unohtamisesta. Morraninkin pitää osallistua jakamalla mainoksia. Autolla se sujuisi, mutta kumpikaan ei osaa ajaa. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Morran ja Tobias
programme.desc: Morranilla on syntymäpäivä. Hän toivoo muuttumisleikkiä ja toiveillallista, kuten TV:ssä. Tobias järjestää molemmat ja laittaa koko homman verkkoon. Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Morran on saanut huomattavan tuen talon saneeraamiseen, mutta alituinen verkossa shoppailu näyttää aina olevan etusijalla. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Fube kuvaa mainosvideota yrityksen uusista osallistamista ja moninaisuutta tukevista arvoista, ja Rut on ymmällään siitä, miksi hän ei saakaan toimia kampanjan kasvoina. Sen sijaan parrasvaloissa paistattelee uusi tulokas Nadja. Ruotsi 2025

programme.title: Hotel Swan Helsinki
programme.desc: 5/8 Minä, tässä, läsnä. Hotelliin tulee vieraaksi kuuluisa meedio, joka näkee tulevaisuuteen. Ella alkaa epäillä, että Henrik on sekaantunut Jessican katoamiseen. Luksushotellimaailmaan sijoittuvassa kotimaisessa draamasarjassa seurataan hotellijohtoa ja -henkilökuntaa murhatutkinnan keskiössä, jossa kaikilla tuntuu olevan jotain salattavaa. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Sininen enkeli
programme.desc: Paljastuksia. Isyyden paljastuminen herättää tunteita ja Outin on aika hyväksyä tosiasiat. Kuka lopulta syyttää ja ketä Lauran onnettomuudesta? MTV-alkuperäissarja Sininen enkeli kuvaa elävästi 1980-luvun värikästä nousukautta Helsingissä, jossa raha kasvaa puissa, avoautot takaavat vauhdin huuman ja solarium on uusi aurinko. Kaupunkiin saapuu maalaistaustaansa piilotteleva Marko Hyyryläinen, joka haluaa oman osansa rahasta ja rakkaudesta. Ohjelma sisältää syrjivää kielenkäyttöä. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Vallan varjot
programme.desc: Valokeilassa. Weissin televisiohaastattelu livahtaa odottamattomille raiteille, ja Ninan rooli lehdistösihteerinä herättää epäilyksiä eri tahoilla. Nurkkaan ajettu Maxie yrittää ottaa selvää, mistä kaikessa on kyse. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Sokaistuneet
programme.desc: Dagbladet on pulassa, ja Rapp uhrautuu itse pelastaakseen lehden. Peder antaa tunteiden ohjata ja auttaa Bean ulos vankilasta. Bea palaa Tukholmaan. Carolina Neurathin todellisuuden innoittamaan romaaniin perustuva jännitysdraama nuoresta toimittajasta, joka ajautuu keskelle valtapelien, rahan ja salaisuuksien maailmaa. Tiivistunnelmaisen sarjan tähtinä Julia Ragnarsson ja Matias Varela. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Top Dog
programme.desc: Ihminen on kuollut, ja kaikki on virhe, josta Devinin jengi joutuu maksamaan. Emilyn ainoa mahdollisuus pelastaa työnsä on ilmiantaa Isak ja Teddy. Erittäin epäsopiva pari - juristi Emily (Josefin Asplund) ja ex-rikollinen Teddy (Alexej Manvelov) - tulevat yhteen jahdatessaan kidnappaajaa. Ruotsalainen trillerisarja perustuu Jens Lapiduksen menestyneeseen kirjatrilogiaan. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Murha Sandhamnissa
programme.desc: Kausi alkaa. Madeleine, osa 1. Poliisiaseman räjähdyksestä on muutama kuukausi, ja sairaalassa tehdään kauhea löytö. Eräs tuttu nousee kuolleista. Tukholman saaristo ei ole niin rauhallinen kuin luulit. Aaltojen lyödessä kallioita vasten rikostarkastaja syyttäjä Nora Linde taistelee arvaamatonta pahuutta vastaan. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Beck: Varjoissa
programme.desc: Tukholman lähiössä tapahtuu kuolettava ampuminen, ja veriteosta epäillään väkivaltaista jengiä. Epäillyt löytyvät pian sidottuina rikospaikan läheltä, ja kaiken taustalla vaikuttaa olevan mystinen hahmo, jolla on hämäriä motiiveja. Beckin tiimi lähtee rajat ylittävään operaatioon löytääkseen jengin johtajan ja selvittääkseen, kuka tuo tuntematon toimija on. Beck: Varjoissa on sarjan 54. elokuva.

programme.title: True Fear
programme.desc: Ystävykset Nour ja Linn pyörittävät suosittua kanavaa "Äkta skräck", jolla he tutkivat kammottavia yliluonnollisia tapahtumia. Eräs seuraaja vinkkaa Ångermanlandissa 1600-luvulla tapahtuneista noitien polttamisista, joissa kuoli 71 ihmistä. Tytöt päättävät lähteä kameroineen selvittämään asiaa, mutta saavat vielä katua päätöstään. Ruotsalaisen kauhuelokuvan tähtinä Ava Nikodell ja Rebecka Enholm.

programme.title: Yksinkertainen murhaaja
programme.desc: Svenillä on huulihalkio, ja koska hänen puhettaan on vaikea ymmärtää, ihmiset kutsuvat häntä Idiootiksi. Kun Svenin äiti kuolee, hänet annetaan tehdaspomo Höglundille, julmalle miehelle, joka kiduttaa mielellään läheisiään. Höglund käyttää Sveniä palkattomana renkinä ja antaa hänen asua navetassaan. Kun Sven tapaa Annan, hän kohtaa lämpöä, iloa ja yhteisyyttä. Annan perhe ei kohtele häntä idioottina vaan hyväksyy hänen vammansa ja antaa hänelle työtä, josta saa palkkaa. Höglund ei halua menettää ilmaista työvoimaa ja kostaa Svenin uusille ystäville.

programme.title: On Set
programme.desc: Viihdeohjelma On Set vie Hollywoodin tähtitehtaan kulissien taakse. 2020

programme.title: Klara
programme.desc: Klara muuttaa uuteen kaupunkiin ja hänellä on vaikeuksia löytää uusia kavereita. Uudet luokkakaverit pitävät ratsastuksesta, joten Klarakin lähtee tallille. Pian hän ilmottautuu jo esteratsastuskisaan, vaikka ei osaa vielä edes ratsastaa. Hevospiireissä hän kuitenkin tapaa suloisen Jonte-pojan. Ruotsalainen koko perheen elokuva.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Lolo Wood CLXVII
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness får Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood veta att Lolo är självsäker på mountainbike i 'Trapputförsåkning'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Lolo Wood CLXVIII
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness går Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood på galna fester i 'Farofester'.

programme.title: Geordie Stories: Charlotte Mam of Two: Tillbaka i Australien!
programme.desc: Charlotte är tillbaka som tvåbarnsmamma till Pixi och Alba, men sen Pixi föddes har relationen med Jake känts ansträngd.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Joeys osäkerhet tar över när Lorena vill skapa ljuv musik med Patrick. David ber äntligen Lateysha om ursäkt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Koh Samui-Kickoff
programme.desc: Ricci berättar för Abbie att han tyckte Leah betedde sig som en narcissist under deras bråk nyligen Abbie tar illa vid sig av hans ordval och de blir osams. Det blir spänt när Jordan and Casey möts ansikte mot ansikte för första gången på månader.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Carly Aquilino XLVII
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness packar Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim, och Carly Aquilino upp sovdagsvansinne i 'Madrasspisk'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Carly Aquilino XLVIII
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness hälsar Rob och Steelo Carly Aquilino välkommen för att bevittna folk som blivit svikna av sina skor i 'Skokörd'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Nina Agdal LIV
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness kollar Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Nina Agdal in 'Hästar som slår bakut'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Carly Aquilino XLIX
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness upplever Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Carly Aquilino baksidan av att vara upp och ner i 'Volta och halka'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Nina Agdal VI
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness litar Rob, Steelo och gästen Nina Agdal för mycket på tillitsfall i 'För stor tillit'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Carly Aquilino L
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness åker Rob, Steelo och Carly Aquilino i 'Rangliga ramper'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Carly Aquilino LII
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness får Rob och Steelo sällskap av Carly Aquilino för att göra 'Grunda dyk'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Carly Aquilino LV
programme.desc: I ett nytt avsnitt av Ridiculousness bryr sig Rob, Steelo och Carly Aquilino för mycket i 'Tävlingslysten till max'.

programme.title: Teen Mom: The Next Chapter: Tänk på dig själv
programme.desc: Brianas mamma Roxanne kommer hem från rehab. Leahs dotter Ali vägrar att använda rullstolen.

programme.title: Teen Mom: The Next Chapter: En enda stor lycklig familj
programme.desc: Briana planerar en familjefotografering, vilket tvingar Roxanne och Brittany att träffas.

programme.title: Teen Mom: The Next Chapter: Hoppas inte för mycket
programme.desc: Amber berättar för Leah om sin förlovning. Maci ordnar grillfest för att fira Ryans första år som drogfri, och den nya familjedynamiken.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Hon är väl girig
programme.desc: Porceyon behöver Tamis hjälp att ta reda på om hans fru Shamika verkligen säljer produkter i sina pop-up-butiker eller om hon träffar nån annan när hon är borta.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Glöm inte skuldpresenten
programme.desc: Skittles pojkvän Edwards kärleksspråk är att ge presenter, men Skittles är ändå skeptisk till att Edward ska bli styvfar till hans barn.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Outtalade förväntningar
programme.desc: Eric träffade Angel vid en modeplåtning och de har varit förälskade sedan dess. Men på senare tid tycks glöden ha falnat.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Skärmdumpa ett magasin
programme.desc: Sierra försöker återta sin plats i Rennis barnpassningsklubb. Saucy berättar om ett traumatiskt möte med ett ex.

programme.title: Ink Master: Shop Wars: Fight Your Own Battles
programme.desc: I Ink Master USA följer vi ett gäng amerikanska konstnärer som tävlar om att bli USAs och kanske världens skickligaste tatuerare.

programme.title: Ink Master: Shop Wars: No Wasted Space
programme.desc: De tävlande tar ett steg åt sidan och litar på sina coacher när Cleen och Christian tatuerar fyra dukar vardera i ett maraton mot varandra.

programme.title: Ink Master: Redemption: Fool Me Twice
programme.desc: Personer som har blivit tatuerade i tävlingen två gånger återvänder och möter sin tatuerare som är tillbaka för att få en ny chans.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Artis & Jess
programme.desc: Tidigare deltagare från Catfish: The TV Show säsong två tar plats i MTV:s Times Square-studio för att svara på tittarnas nyfikna frågor.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Prophet & Trinity
programme.desc: Prophet, från Grammynominerade Nappy Roots, ska göra comeback och har samtidigt fått kontakt med Trinity på nätet.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Spencer & Katy
programme.desc: Spencer avslöjar en hemlighet för Nev och Max, som han hållit för sig själv de senaste sex åren.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Sheila & Rich Dollaz
programme.desc: Nev och Nick Young, eller Swaggy P, försöker hjälpa Sheila ta reda på om det är Rich Dollaz från "Love & Hip Hop" som har tagit kontakt med henne.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Taylor & Christian
programme.desc: Taylor har fallit för en kille som påstår sig ha gått i hennes gamla skola, men hon minns honom inte. Nev och Tallulah börjar gräva.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Skvaller och dissar
programme.desc: Jasmines möte med Kirk & Rasheeda ger henne frostskador. Momma Dees nya påhitt ger Scrappys nåt att tänka på.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: I foodtrucken
programme.desc: Lojalitet och vänskap prövas när otrohet är på menyn. Kocken Shay misstänker att hennes pojkvän sen långt tillbaka, Tony.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Naimah & Maher
programme.desc: Naimah och Maher var klassens clowner och blev bästa kompisar direkt. När Naimah tog värvning blev det allt svårare att hålla vänskapen vid liv.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Jag är en ikon på tävlingsdansscenen
programme.desc: Alexis och Trenton träffades på tävlingsdansscenen.

programme.title: Ink Master: Shop Wars: Ingen dag på stranden
programme.desc: En sandig snabbutmaning tvingar lagen till gränsen, medan smältande tatueringar och ett utbrott får det att hetta till i tävlingen om 250 000.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Tillbaka till naturen!
programme.desc: Nathan frågar James rent ut om han har baktalat honom och det hela blir spänt. Familjen blir nostalgisk och reflekterar över sin tid i serien.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Paige DeSorbo II
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' försöker Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim och Paige DeSorbo undvika att få näsorna på sned i 'Näsborrschock'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Lolo Wood XLII
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av 'Ridiculousness' ska Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood åka elsparkcykel i 'Sparkcykelgyckel'.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling och Lolo Wood XLIII
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet av Ridiculousness har Rob, Steelo och Lolo Wood skoj med 'Festråttor'.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers: Christina Aguilera
programme.desc: Christina Aguilera bjuder fansen på en intim konsert och berättar vad som har inspirerat låtarna.

programme.title: Tiedän mitä teit viime kesänä
programme.desc: Eräänä kesäyönä joukko nuoria ajaa vahingossa autollaan kalastajan päälle. Kun he eivät saa häntä elvytettyä, he luulevat tämän kuolleen ja heittävät paniikissa ruumiin mereen. Seuraavana kesänä he alkavat saada outoja kirjeitä, joissa lukee: ”Tiedän, mitä teit viime kesänä.” Pian heitä vainoaa mies sadetakissa ja terävä koukku kädessään. Klassinen 90‑luvun kauhuelokuva.

programme.desc: Ruotsalainen romanttinen komedia eri-ikäisistä ihmisistä, joiden elämät punoutuvat yhteen sattumien ja rakkaudenkaipuun ansiosta.

programme.title: Onnen kukkuloilla

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Anne Hathaway. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Göta Kanal 4
programme.desc: On uuden hullunhauskan retken aika Göta-kanavalla. Vauhdikkaan kilpailun voittaja saa haltuunsa klassisen Anderssonin telakan.

programme.title: Kunnian miehiä
programme.desc: Neljä Oscar-ehdokkuutta saanut, Rob Reinerin ohjaama draama, pääosissa Jack Nicholson, Tom Cruise ja Demi Moore.

programme.title: Almost Famous - Melkein julkkis
programme.desc: Vuoteen 1973 sijoittuva musiikkidraama kertoo nuoresta Williamista, joka kirjoittaa rokkijuttuja koululehteen ja unelmoi itsekin rocktähteydestä. Unelmat lähenevät, kun hän lähtee kiertämään aloittelevan Rollings Stonesin kanssa. Elokuvan käsikirjoitus palkittiin Oscarilla. Ohjaaja: Cameron Crowe. Pääosissa: Billy Crudup, Kate Hudson.

programme.title: Armoton maa
programme.desc: Cowboyt Boss, Charley, Mose ja Button kuljettavat karjaa 1880-luvun Keskilännessä. Mose lähetetään Harmonvilleen hakemaan tarvikkeita, mutta hän ei palaa. Miehet matkaavat kaupunkiin ja huomaavat, että Mose on pidätetty. Pian selviää, että sheriffi on korruptoitunut ja että aluetta hallitsee vaikutusvaltainen tilanomistaja. Yhteenotto on väistämätön.

programme.title: Arn - Temppeliritari
programme.desc: Jan Guilloun kirjat Arn Magnussonista ovat taustana kalleimmalle Ruotsissa koskaan tehdylle filmisijoitukselle. Ensimmäisessä elokuvassa seuraamme Arnin kasvuvuosia luostarissa Länsi-Götanmaalla hänen Jerusalemiin lähettämiseensä asti.

programme.title: What's love got to do with it?
programme.desc: Miten nykymaailmassa oikein löytää rakkauden? Tässä romanttisessa komediassa tapaamme Lontoossa lapsuudenystävät Zoen ja Kazin, joiden tapa lähestyä ihmissuhteita on erilainen.

programme.title: Winnerbäck - ett slags liv
programme.desc: Tämä dokumenttielokuva Lars Winnerbäckistä vie meidät lähemmäs muusikkoa kuin koskaan ja tiivistää musikaalisesti epätodennäköisen uran. 2017

programme.title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
programme.desc: Romanttinen draama Jojo Moyesin bestsellerin pohjalta kahdesta eri aikakausien naisesta, jotka jäävät arvoituksellisten rakkauskirjeiden pauloihin.

programme.title: The Equalizer: oikeuden puolustaja
programme.desc: Amerikkalainen toimintaelokuva syrjäänvetäytyvästä miehestä, jonka väkivaltaisen puolen julmat gangsterit herättävät eloon.

programme.title: Scream 5
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sen jälkeen, kun Woodsboron kaupunkia järkytti sarja raakoja murhia, se tapahtuu taas. Menneisyyden salaisuudet paljastuvat, kun tekijä riehuu viidennen kerran. Nyt vain pari eloonjäänyttä voi pysäyttää murhaajan Ghostface-maskin takana.

programme.title: Tanssii susien kanssa
programme.desc: Vuonna 1863 Yhdysvaltain sisällissodassa taisteleva luutnantti John Dunbar lähetetään kaukaiseen tukikohtaan Dakotassa. Linnoitus on hylätty, mutta Dunbar päättää jäädä. Hän ystävystyy vähitellen paikallisen sioux-heimon kanssa – ja joutuu pian valitsemaan puolensa. Kevin Costnerin eeppinen western palkittiin seitsemällä Oscarilla, muun muassa parhaasta elokuvasta ja ohjauksesta.

Zephyrin on keksittävä keino päästä pois, ennen kuin hänestä tulee hainruokaa. Ylistettyä kauhutrilleriä tähdittävät Hassie Harrison (Yellowstone) ja Jai Courtney (Suicide Squad, Divergent).

Dr Pol har som vanligt fullt upp men finner ändå tid att hjälpa Charles grand danoisvalp, Atlas. PÅ PVS-kliniken är "9 till 5" mer idé än praktik. Våra tappra veterinärer arbetar oförtröttligt vidare så länge behovet finns.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic-utforskaren Bertie Gregory återvänder till honungsbinas systerskap och deras kamp mot klockan för att återuppbygga samhället inför vintern. Runt om i världen står andra bin inför egna utmaningar, från dawsonbin som slåss om partners till honungsbin som hotas av varroakvalster. Tillsammans med dr Sammy Ramsey utforskar Bertie trycket på bina och de djärva lösningar som kan säkra deras framtid.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory avslöjar binas hemliga värld och de storartade hemligheterna bakom deras framgång. Från "kvastbiets" snillrika arkitetktur till det köttätande biet i Amazonas regnskog – deras begåvningar visas upp tillsammans med nya insikter om biintelligens. Följ ett honungsbi genom livet och se hur hennes systrar kämpar för att överleva vintern i den livliga kupan.

programme.title: Secrets of the Elephants
programme.desc: Kongos regnskog är hem till en av världens mest hemlighetsfulla arter, den afrikanska skogselefanten. Allting med dem, deras kroppar, deras beteenden och deras familjer, är anpassat till livet i regnskogen. Men att överleva här innebär mer än att anpassa sig. De här elefanterna har format skogen runt sig efter sina behov, och därmed skapat en livsmiljö olik någon annan på jorden.

programme.title: Super Reefs
programme.desc: År 2009 utforskade National Geographic Pristine Seas de södra Linjeöarna och fann orörda korallrev, blomstrande ekosystem som vimlade av hajar och enorma fiskstim. Men under 2015-16 dödade en aldrig tidigare skådad havsuppvärmning hälften av korallerna. Pristine Seas-teamet återvände 2021 i hopp om att se några tecken på återhämtning. Vad de fann istället var den mest spektakulära återhämtningen av korallrev som någonsin skådats.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Red Sun Rampant
programme.desc: Japan attacks the USA on 7 Dec 1941. For the next 6 months, they continue to have successful attacks.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Mediterranean and North Africa
programme.desc: Italy's failed attacks in the Mediterranean region draw in the Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.
